content.title: Masters 2026: Winner’s Payout & Prize Money Earnings
content.text: Apr 12, 2026, 7:13 PM min read (AP Photo/Jae C. Hong) The 2026 Masters was April 9-12 The total purse for 2026 was $22.5 million. The first-place money was $4.5 million. The Masters is the best week of the year in golf, especially for PGA Tour betting. In another thrilling event, Rory McIlroy held off the rest of the field to win for the second straight year. He finished at 12-under, which was good for a one-shot win. The purse was $22.5 million in 2026, up from $21 million in 2025. How Much Does the Winner of the Masters Make? Rory McIlroy’s winner’s share for the 2026 Masters was $4.5 million.
